changelog: Waiting means their words. After you replied to someone, their next session could open with their own message echoed back as if it had just arrived; now a waiting message is always the other person's newest words. And handles keep their dashes — a GitHub login like synth-stan is looked up as written, so the thread opens instead of coming back empty.
features: A waiting message at session start is always the other person's newest message, never your own reply
Handles with dashes open the right thread
Long threads read from the end, and the startup check finishes inside its time budget
